content_zh:
“我也觉得。”
“这女子中学漂亮妞多着呢，人傻钱多，随便以恐吓不是手到擒来，何必纠结这么一个……”
“你们懂个屁，这叫做品位。”徐冰狠狠的瞪了这群人一眼。
正不爽这群人品位低的时候，徐冰一抬头，看见一个穿着黑色衬衫的少年寒气冰冰的朝着这个亭子走来。
咦，这货有点眼熟啊？
我草，说曹操曹操就到，这小子不就是小妞的隔壁家哥哥吗！
好家伙，早就想收拾你这个三番五次阻碍我泡妞的东西了，没想到你自己送上门来，正好哥几个兄弟今天都在，就给你好好尝尝被围殴的滋味，让你以后还不敢不敢做出头鸟！
“兄弟们，抄家伙！”徐冰豁然站了起来，目光与莫凡那双冷眼对接。
牛仔装男，叼烟青年，头戴男，羽绒服男唰的一下站了起来，四下往旁边看了看……
“哥，我们没带家伙。”叼烟青年凑到徐冰耳边，弱弱的说了一句。
“你妈的，对付这小东西还要用家伙吗，给我往死里打，赵坤三兄弟都吩咐了，打残了算他的！”徐冰一巴掌盖在多嘴的小弟脑门上，恼怒的说道。
叼烟小弟一脸委屈，明明是你自己说抄家伙的……原来就是一个场面话。
“既然是赵坤三兄弟吩咐过的……呵呵呵！”羽绒服男一下子就把羽绒服给脱了，露出了白色的背心，一身夸张的肌肉爆了出来！
莫凡用看畜生一样的眼神注视着这五个所谓青熊帮的杂碎。
“哼，小子，我就这么跟你说吧，像你妹妹这样女的，我徐兵能够看上她就是她几辈子的福分了，你以为每个人都像我徐兵这样不介意她是一个……一个……残疾人？像这种残疾人，还有什么好装圣女的，有人要，就赶紧烧钱拜佛了！！”徐兵指着莫凡，顿时原形毕露！
这些年，徐兵的耐心也早用光了。
不看看他徐兵，要相貌有相貌，有势力有势力，在这一片广池区怎么也是个人物，叶心夏跟了自己以后好歹也能够吃香喝辣，小弟跟前跟后！
“就是，别那么不识抬举！”
“现在乖乖叫一声妹夫，我们就看在一家人的份上对你下手轻一点，给赵坤三和慕白一个交代就行了，要是再倔，那就打断你的腿，让你陪她坐轮椅去！”白色背心的健身男说道。
听完这番话，莫凡的胸膛剧烈的起伏着。

他看了一眼亭子。
亭子中央正放着一个孤零零的轮椅，轮椅上是散乱的扑克牌。
原本，看到这些人渣把叶心夏的轮椅当做打牌的桌子时，他已经愤怒至极，此刻再听到徐兵那极大侮辱的话语，莫凡感觉自己胸腔要爆炸了！！
残疾人？？
残疾人？？？？
我莫凡发过毒誓，谁敢再这样说叶心夏一句，一定会让他后悔这辈子投胎做了人！
“别跟这小子废话了，揍他丫的！”
“我一个人就够了，哥几个一边看着。”白色背心的健身男开始抱拳，发出咯咯咯的响声。
莫凡就那样看着他们，眼睛冰冷到了极致。
这些市井混混并没有留意到的是，在他那双瞳孔之中，正映射出了一道紫色雷怒的轨迹，蕴藏着庞大雷之力的星轨正在莫凡的怒火下化为了一个即将喷发的火山！！
“你们真的以为我还是那个任你们宰割的莫凡？？”
一股躁动的力量在莫凡周围的空气中跃动着，它们就像是一个个全副武装却又等待将军命令的士兵！
“正好，让你们这般畜生不如的东西尝尝雷的滋味！”
怒语从喉咙中吼出，这一刻，七颗星子连成一线，化作星之轨迹，将整个雷系星尘之中的力量全部灌输到了莫凡的右臂上！
“滋~~~~~~~~~~~~~~”
一道触目惊心的雷弧如同蟒蛇一样在莫凡周身一闪而逝，下一秒，空气中那些躁动的雷元素疯狂的聚集在了莫凡的右臂上，发出了刺耳的鸣叫！
“我的天啊！！！！”
“这是什么？？？”
“为什么他身体周围像是触电一样噼啪乱响！”
“这小子……天啊，他是一名魔法师！！”徐兵终究是这班人中最见过世面的，“法师”一词更是呼之欲出！

他们确实是一群广池区非常有名的混混，但混混依旧也是靠拳打脚踢，在一个真正的法师面前，他们连渣渣都不算！！

content_en:
"I think so too."
"There are a lot of pretty girls in this girls' middle school. People are stupid and have a lot of money. It's not easy to threaten them easily. Why bother with such a one..."
"You know nothing, this is called taste." Xu Bing glared at this group of people.
Just when he was dissatisfied with the low taste of this group of people, Xu Bing looked up and saw a young man in a black shirt walking towards the pavilion with a cold air.
Hey, does this guy look familiar?
Damn it, just say Cao Cao and Cao Cao will be here. Isn’t this guy the little girl’s brother next door?
Good guy, I have long wanted to clean up your things that have repeatedly hindered me from picking up girls. I didn’t expect you to come to my door yourself. It just so happens that several brothers are here today. I will give you a good taste of being beaten so that you don’t dare to be the first in the future!
"Brothers, copy the guy!" Xu Bing suddenly stood up and his eyes met Mo Fan's cold eyes.
The man in jeans, the young man smoking cigarettes, the man wearing a hat, and the man in a down jacket suddenly stood up and looked around...
"Brother, we didn't bring anyone with us." The cigarette-smoking young man leaned into Xu Bing's ear and said weakly.
"Damn it, do you still need to use a dick to deal with this little guy? Beat me to death. The three brothers Zhao and Kun have given orders. It's his fault if you cripple him!" Xu Bing slapped the talkative little brother on the head and said angrily.
The cigarette-smoking guy looked aggrieved. It was obviously you who said he copied this guy...it turned out to be just a scene.
"Since it was the three brothers Zhao Kun who gave the order...hehehe!" The man in the down jacket took off his down jacket in one fell swoop, revealing his white vest and his exaggerated muscles!
Mo Fan looked at these five so-called Green Bear Gang's bastards like animals.
"Hmph, boy, let me tell you this, for a girl like your sister, I, Xu Bing, can fall in love with her and it will be her blessing for several lifetimes. Do you think everyone is like me, Xu Bing, who doesn't mind that she is...a...disabled person? How can a disabled person like this pretend to be a saint? If someone wants it, just burn money and worship the Buddha!!" Xu Bing pointed at Mo Fan, and his true colors were revealed!
Over the years, Xu Bing's patience has long been exhausted.
If you don’t look at Xu Bing, he must be good-looking, powerful, and powerful. He is still a figure in this Guangchi area. After Ye Xinxia follows him, he will be able to be popular and drink hot food. The younger brother will follow him!
"That's right, don't be so disrespectful!"
"Now call me brother-in-law. For the sake of the family, we will be gentle on you and give Zhao Kunsan and Mubai an explanation. If you are still stubborn, we will break your legs and let you accompany her in the wheelchair!" said the fitness man in a white vest.
After hearing these words, Mo Fan's chest heaved violently.
He glanced at the pavilion.
There is a lonely wheelchair in the center of the pavilion, and there are scattered playing cards on the wheelchair.
Originally, when he saw these scum using Ye Xinxia's wheelchair as a table for playing cards, he was already extremely angry. Now when he heard Xu Bing's extremely insulting words, Mo Fan felt like his chest was going to explode! !
Disabled? ?
Disabled? ? ? ?
I, Mo Fan, have sworn a poisonous oath. Whoever dares to say such words to Ye Xinxia again will definitely make him regret being reincarnated as a human being!
"Stop talking nonsense to this kid and beat him up!"
"It's enough for me alone, and the brothers are watching." The fitness man in the white vest began to clasp his fists, making a gurgling sound.
Mo Fan just looked at them like that, his eyes were extremely cold.
What these street gangsters didn't notice was that in his pupils, a purple thunder path was reflected, and the star path containing huge thunder power was turning into a volcano about to erupt under Mo Fan's anger! !
"Do you really think I am still the Mo Fan who is at your mercy??"
A restless force was leaping in the air around Mo Fan. They seemed to be fully armed butSoldiers waiting for the general's orders!
"Just in time, let the beasts like you taste the taste of thunder!"
Angry words roared from the throat. At this moment, seven stars connected in a line and turned into star trails, instilling all the power in the thunder system stardust into Mo Fan's right arm!
"Zi~~~~~~~~~~~~~~"
A shocking lightning arc flashed around Mo Fan like a python. The next second, the restless thunder elements in the air gathered crazily on Mo Fan's right arm, making a piercing cry!
“OMG!!!!”
"What is this???"
"Why is there a crackling sound around his body like an electric shock!"
"This kid... Oh my god, he is a magician!!" Xu Bing is the most experienced among this group of people after all, and the word "mage" is even more vivid!
They are indeed a group of very famous gangsters in Guangchi District, but gangsters still rely on punching and kicking. In front of a real mage, they are not even scum! !
